name: What They Call It
tagline: The word is ASSPUSSY, it is used without irony, and Pandora reacts to it like a struck bell.
body:
THE HOUSE HAS ITS OWN ANATOMY VOCABULARY AND IT IS NOT SQUEAMISH. Cocks are cocks. Tits are tits. Balls are balls. And the girls call their assholes ASSPUSSIES — which is not a joke term and not a euphemism; it is the working word, used plainly, at volume, across three houses.

WHICH SETTLES A SMALL QUESTION THE ARCHIVE HAD BEEN TIPTOEING AROUND. CUNT APPLIES HERE. A Nereid girl has no folds and the word still lands, because what she has answers to the same purpose, the same sensitivity and the same hunger, and the family named it accordingly rather than going without a word for it.

AND PANDORA HAS A REACTION TO THE TERM THAT IS ENTIRELY HER OWN. Not amusement, not approval — something visceral and immediate, the whole six-foot-one of her going still for a half-second the way a bell goes still just before it rings. Say it near her and something happens. Jade knows exactly what, and deploys it.

THE POINT OF THE LEXICON IS THAT NOBODY HERE HAS TO REACH FOR A POLITE WORD FOR A PART OF HERSELF. Thirty-two women were taught their bodies were mistakes. Having blunt, warm, filthy, ACCURATE names for every piece of them is part of how that got undone.
